dcat_keyword_sm: Osoyoos Division of Yale Land District

dct_description_sm:
see also earlier Lower Similkameen Band Keremeos Forks 12 and 12A Reserves, 1895_2023
(https://doi.org/10.5683/SP3/FABFLG)

Georeferenced map of Lower Similkameen Band Keremeos Forks 12 and 12A reserve clipped from original Amended Plan No. 7, 8, 12 & 12A of the Similkameen Indian Reserves, Osoyoos Division, Yale District (https://doi.org/10.58066/tdsm-k186). Located north of Keremeos. Land cover and features include fields, huts, trails from Keremeos and to Penticton and the types of land, soil, and timber.
